snippet.title: MAIDNIGHT OP - End of the Night ft. Kasane Teto
snippet.description:
The opening movie of the free visual novel MAIDNIGHT, created by AOKORO and VioletBooks.

Lyrics:
I wanna shine brighter than the city lights that never sleep
But who am I to fight for this when I'm tired by the end of the night

Wake up dawn, wash up my clothes
Take a full train, make up my face
Scrub all the plates, serve all the drinks
Smile at every stranger I meet and...
Do all of that on four hours sleep
Do all of that and please who I meet
And do all of that for minimum wage
And do all of that performing on stage and...

I can't take this anymore
But still I won't give up hope just yet
So I'll keep on working hard
'Til it breaks me

I wanna shine brighter than the city lights that never sleep
But who am I to fight for this when I'm crying by the end of the night
I'll keep on trying to be a star
Do everything I can so that I can go far enough
One day I hope I'll light the sky
Shine on you by the end of the night
